name: Ask questions about a PDF using AI
description: This workflow fetches a PDF from Google Drive, splits it into chunks, embeds the chunks using OpenAI embeddings, and enables chat interactions with the document content.

nodes.label: Params: Insert into Pinecone vector store

setupVars.label: Pinecone index host (create the index with integrated embedding and field map text=text)

source.path: PDF_and_Document_Processing/Ask questions about a PDF using AI.json

setup: "When clicking 'Chat' button below" (chatTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value pineconeNamespace: Pinecone namespace for this collection (for example documents). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

Setup value pineconeIndexHost: Pinecone index host (create the index with integrated embedding and field map text=text) (for example my-index-abc123.svc.aped-4627-b74a.pinecone.io). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value driveFileId: Google Drive file id (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

hints: Provide `chatInput` (and optionally `sessionId`) as run inputs; the original started from a chat message.
"Question and Answer Chain" folded a retriever (retrieverVectorStore); retrieved text is expected on the upstream payload as context/documents.
"Question and Answer Chain" (chainRetrievalQa): Retriever output should arrive as context/documents/text on the upstream payload.
"Insert into Pinecone vector store" folded a document (documentDefaultDataLoader); retrieved text is expected on the upstream payload as context/documents.

"Insert into Pinecone vector store" (vectorStorePinecone.insert): The original used a Pinecone index with a separate embeddings node; here the default vector store is a Pinecone index with integrated embedding (upsert records), so Pinecone embeds the text itself.

"Insert into Pinecone vector store": create a Pinecone index with integrated embedding (for example llama-text-embed-v2, field map text=text) and set pineconeIndexHost; the store uses the namespace "{{pineconeNamespace}}".
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect pinecone: `cdecli credential create -n "pinecone" -p pinecone --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
### Load data into database
Fetch file from Google Drive, split it into chunks and insert into Pinecone index

### Chat with database
Embed the incoming chat message and use it retrieve relevant chunks from the vector store. These are passed to the model to formulate an answer

## Try me out
1. In Pinecone, create an index with 1536 dimensions and select it in *both* Pinecone nodes
2. Click 'test workflow' at the bottom of the canvas to load data into the vector store
3. Click 'chat' at the bottom of the canvas to ask questions about the data
